newsitem.title: USA: Jordanian monarch arrives for summit.
newsitem.headline: Jordanian monarch arrives for summit.

text.p: King Hussein of Jordan arrived in Washington on Monday night for a Middle East crisis summit at the White House with the leaders of Israel and the Palestinians.

Hussein's aircraft landed at Andrews Air Force Base in nearby Maryland about 7.20 p.m. (2320 GMT), a base spokesman said. The King left directly for the White House and a meeting with President Bill Clinton.

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Palestinian President Yasser Arafat will join Hussein at Tuesday's hastily-arranged summit to discuss the recent violence that has threatened to derail the Middle East peace process.
